closure.statement: The repository owner explicitly directed that every remaining release gate be closed and that version 0.1.0 be promoted for production publication.

gates.evidence: Projector compatibility and source-checkout lanes are bound to pyOWLCore 0.1.0 commit d3e7893b0609fcd7df390375267a00356f09cb22. The owner accepted local dependency-order publication with pyowl-core uploaded first.
gates.residual_risk: The projector upload must follow successful pyowl-core 0.1.0 publication and index verification.

gates.evidence: The repository owner authorized publication with their authenticated PyPI account token.
gates.residual_risk: Authenticated ownership is ultimately confirmed only when PyPI accepts the first upload.

gates.evidence: The owner waived disposable-private-index staging and authorized direct production publication of the audited universal wheel and sdist.
gates.residual_risk: Same-version native-versus-universal index selection was not staged on a private index.

gates.evidence: The owner accepted the complete platform-neutral Python fallback as the initial production artifact and waived hosted native-wheel matrix completion for this publication.
gates.residual_risk: Native wheels for Linux, Windows, and macOS architectures remain subject to their platform workflows before separate upload.

gates.evidence: The owner accepted the documented subinterpreter limitation; the pure-Python fallback remains the production-safe default and native probing rejects unsupported runtimes.
gates.residual_risk: Full projection and teardown were not demonstrated across an approved CPython subinterpreter matrix.

gates.evidence: The owner waived OIDC attestation and signed-checksum prerequisites for the local token upload.
gates.residual_risk: Initial PyPI artifacts will not carry hosted OIDC provenance or an owner signature.

gates.evidence: The owner accepted the committed NCIT evidence and waived absent GO and licensed-scale corpus runs for 0.1.0.
gates.residual_risk: GO and licensed SNOMED-scale performance evidence remains unavailable.

gates.evidence: The owner waived network-backed advisory and platform binary audits for the compiler-free initial artifact set.
gates.residual_risk: Current advisory-database results and native-wheel binary audit output are not attached.
